name: VAPEUR-RCT
question: In sexually active men with symptomatic benign prostatic obstruction, does Rezūm water vapor thermal therapy improve urinary symptoms and preserve sexual function better than an alpha-blocker plus a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor?

design.population: 151 sexually active men with symptomatic benign prostatic obstruction were randomized.
design.description: Multicenter, pragmatic, open-label superiority randomized trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Background and objective; Methods; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04838769, Study Design

verdictNote: IPSS superiority met; sexual-function superiority was not demonstrated after multiple imputation.
takeaway: In sexually active men with benign prostatic obstruction, Rezūm water vapor therapy improved 1-year IPSS more than an alpha-blocker plus a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor; superiority for sexual-function preservation was not demonstrated after multiple imputation.

"Water Vapor Thermal Therapy with Rezūm Versus Combination Pharmacotherapy for Male Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms due to Benign Prostatic Obstruction: 1-Yr Results From a Prospective, Multicenter, Pragmatic Randomized Controlled Trial (VAPEUR-RCT)." *Eur Urol Focus.* 2026 Aug 18:S2405-4569(26)00175-6. doi:10.1016/j.euf.2026.08.001
